content: UNP64 (iAN CooG) is a generic C64 PRG unpacker, latest v2.41 (2026), source included, distributed via CSDb. It is a Windows console executable (unp64.exe); on Linux it must run under Wine. It works by emulating the 6502 and detecting the decrunch-then-jump-to-normal-address pattern, often aided by signature matching for known crunchers. No public evidence it recognizes the obscure 'TCS-CRUNCH!' signature used in this project's disk.
